title: Reentrancy in withdraw()
impact: Attacker can drain contract funds through recursive calls
description: The withdraw function updates the balance after making an external call, allowing an attacker to recursively call withdraw before the balance is updated.
recommendation: Apply the checks-effects-interactions pattern by updating balances before making external calls, or use OpenZeppelin's ReentrancyGuard.

title: Missing Access Control on emergencyWithdraw
impact: Anyone can drain all contract funds
description: The emergencyWithdraw function lacks access control, allowing any user to withdraw all funds from the contract.
recommendation: Add an onlyOwner modifier or use OpenZeppelin's Ownable/AccessControl.
